user.title: WLED Alerts
user.description: A **zone** is a stretch of LEDs on a WLED strip where alerts show up. An **alert** is one thing to show there (garage open, doorbell…). Create a zone first.

menu_options.alert: Alert (when to light up, what color)

zone.title: New zone
zone.description: Pick the WLED controller and the LEDs to use. LED numbers start at 0 at the end where the strip is wired.

data.name: Name
data.night_entity: Night mode when this is on

data_description.host: Pick a WLED device HA already knows, or type an IP address.
data_description.anchor: Alerts stack from this end of the zone, most important first.
data_description.block_size: If there isn't room for every alert, blocks shrink (down to 2 LEDs) and the least important ones are left out.
data_description.night_entity: For example a schedule like Night Dimming. Optional.

alert.title: New alert
alert.description: Write a template that is true while the alert should show. Example: `{{ is_state('cover.garage_door', 'open') }}`

data.name: Name
data.delay: Only after it's been true for

data_description.mode: Condition: lit while the template is true. Momentary: the template returns something that changes when the event happens (e.g. the last doorbell press time) and the alert shows for a while.
data_description.delay: Condition alerts only. E.g. garage open for 5 minutes.
data_description.dismissible: Adds a Dismiss button. A dismissed alert stays hidden until its condition clears, then re-arms.
data_description.full_strip: Takes over the entire strip while showing (good for the doorbell).

error.out_of_range: That LED range runs past the end of the strip.
error.invalid_template: The template has a syntax error.

abort.no_zones: Create a zone first (Create helper → WLED Alerts → Zone).
